floorPlans.introduction: Compare four-bedroom Villa A and Villa B in Styles 1 and 2. The original pack shows regular and mirrored layouts, each with three floors.
floorPlans.note: The plot key identifies the regular or mirrored variant. Total area includes the terrace or balcony and carport. Confirm your signed plan and area.

review.images: Matched the official wide image and six gallery scenes. Omitted the narrower hero duplicate. One exterior and three interiors are byte-identical across Selvara 3 and 4 and identified as shared. The card uses the distinct wide phase image.
review.location: Checked the named developer point, cluster map on physical page 9 and the brochure estimates on physical page 6. Brochure and general community site estimate scopes differ. Community comparison: https://www.emaar.com/en/our-communities/grand-polo-club-and-resort
review.floorPlans: Reviewed the 9-page original labelled Selvara 3 throughout. All 8 complete three-level layouts and their own phase key plans were reviewed. The official shared filename delivered the Selvara 4 booklet. Used the exact Madena-hosted Emaar booklet for this phase. Printed imperial components reconcile within 0.01 sq ft.

unavailable: The shared download on the Emaar project page contains Selvara 4 materials. The displayed map and plans use phase-specific Emaar documents hosted by Mitchell’s and Madena respectively.
Signed unit-specific areas and entrance-level routes were not verified.
